svg.title: See why two enforced moves conflict
svg.desc: Vector illustration using the App crowded-cell tip. Row 1 forces 4 and column 1 forces 7 into row 1 column 1; one cell cannot hold both.

g.text: Row 1 has only one place left for 4.
Column 1 has only one place left for 7.
Both are forced into the same cell.
The red boxes show the conflict.
